verdicts.reason: A scatters the copy into separate pieces: the eyebrow sits top-left, the headline sits lower-left, and the small body line floats at a third height with nothing to align to. The peach circle has shrunk to a meaningless blob in the corner, cut off by the edge, so the bottle has lost its backdrop. B keeps the circle behind the bottle and has a strong headline hierarchy, but it is cramped. The eyebrow sits in line with the headline and almost touches the left edge. The oversized Shop Sale button is jammed against the bottom edge and pressed up to the bottle. The right side is overcrowded while the left side is empty.
